title: 2471. Minimum Number of Operations to Sort a Binary Tree by Level

examples.explanation: - Swap 4 and 3. The 2nd level becomes [3,4]. - Swap 7 and 5. The 3rd level becomes [5,6,8,7]. - Swap 8 and 7. The 3rd level becomes [5,6,7,8]. We used 3 operations so return 3. It can be proven that 3 is the minimum number of operations needed.

- Swap 3 and 2. The 2nd level becomes [2,3]. - Swap 7 and 4. The 3rd level becomes [4,6,5,7]. - Swap 6 and 5. The 3rd level becomes [4,5,6,7]. We used 3 operations so return 3. It can be proven that 3 is the minimum number of operations needed.
Each level is already sorted in increasing order so return 0.
